title: HP TET JBT · September 2018 (previous year questions)
description: Questions asked in the HP TET JBT exam held on 2 September 2018, with answers checked against a published solved paper and independently verified. Not the complete paper: garbled or doubtful questions were left out.

questions.text: A girl is born when ........ chromosomes are paired.
questions.textHi: एक लड़की का जन्म तब होता है जब ........ गुणसूत्र जोड़े बनाते हैं।
questions.explanation: A female has two X chromosomes (XX); a male has XY. (Q1 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: The information processing model of memory was given by
questions.textHi: स्मृति का सूचना प्रक्रमण मॉडल किसने प्रतिपादित किया?
questions.explanation: Atkinson and Shiffrin (1968) proposed the multi-store information processing model of memory. (Q2 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: If a father refuses to give a toy even after prolonged crying by the child, the result will be
questions.textHi: यदि बच्चे के बहुत देर तक रोने के बाद भी पिता खिलौना देने से मना कर दे, तो इसका परिणाम होगा
questions.explanation: When crying is no longer rewarded, the response gradually disappears: extinction. (Q3 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Which of the following is the first step in the scientific method of problem-solving?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा समस्या समाधान की वैज्ञानिक विधि का पहला चरण है?
questions.explanation: Scientific problem-solving begins with becoming aware of (identifying) the problem. (Q4 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: According to Piaget, at which stage does a child begin to think logically about abstract propositions?
questions.textHi: पियाजे के अनुसार, किस अवस्था में बच्चा अमूर्त प्रस्तावों के बारे में तार्किक चिंतन करना शुरू करता है?
questions.explanation: Abstract, hypothetical reasoning begins in the formal operational stage (about 11+ years). (Q5 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Which one of the following is an example of a fine motor skill?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सूक्ष्म गामक कौशल का उदाहरण है?
questions.explanation: Fine motor skills use small muscles of the hands and fingers, as in writing. (Q6 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Homework is given to students mainly
options: for the development of writing skills
so that the students study at home
to know how much of the lesson the students have understood
questions.textHi: विद्यार्थियों को गृहकार्य मुख्यतः किसलिए दिया जाता है?
optionsHi: ताकि विद्यार्थी घर पर अध्ययन करें
यह जानने के लिए कि विद्यार्थियों ने पाठ कितना समझा
questions.explanation: Homework mainly helps the teacher check how much of the lesson pupils have understood and reinforces it. (Q7 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: The IQ of morons lies between
questions.textHi: 'मूढ़' (मोरोन) श्रेणी के बालकों की बुद्धि-लब्धि होती है
questions.explanation: In the old classification, morons had an IQ of about 50–70 (here 50–75). (Q8 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: The chief aim of a psychological experiment is to
questions.textHi: मनोवैज्ञानिक प्रयोग का प्रमुख उद्देश्य होता है
questions.explanation: Experiments are designed to discover cause-and-effect relationships. (Q11 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Development includes changes from
questions.textHi: विकास में परिवर्तन होते हैं
questions.explanation: Development is a lifelong process from conception to death. (Q12 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Erikson's stages are categorised on the basis of
questions.textHi: एरिक्सन की अवस्थाओं का वर्गीकरण किस आधार पर किया गया है?
questions.explanation: Each of Erikson's stages centres on resolving a psychosocial (social) conflict. (Q13 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: The ego operates on the basis of the
questions.textHi: 'अहम्' किस सिद्धांत के आधार पर संचालित होता है?
questions.explanation: The ego works on the reality principle, balancing the id and the super-ego. (Q14 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Morality based on existing social norms is found at the ........ level of moral development (Kohlberg).
questions.textHi: कोहलबर्ग के अनुसार नैतिक विकास के ........ स्तर पर प्रचलित सामाजिक मानकों के आधार पर नैतिकता तय की जाती है।
questions.explanation: At Kohlberg's conventional level, right and wrong are judged by social rules and norms. (Q15 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: ........ is our working memory system.
questions.textHi: हमारी कार्यकारी स्मृति प्रणाली ........ है।
questions.explanation: Short-term memory works as our working memory. (Q16 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: The most suitable test to measure the intelligence of a nine-year-old child is
questions.textHi: नौ वर्षीय बालक की बुद्धि मापने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त परीक्षण है
questions.explanation: WISC (Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children) is for ages 6–16; WPPSI is for pre-schoolers, WAIS for adults. (Q18 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: A child's tendency to respond to stimuli that are similar to the conditioned stimulus is called
questions.textHi: अनुबंधित उद्दीपक के समान अन्य उद्दीपकों के प्रति भी अनुक्रिया करने की बालक की प्रवृत्ति कहलाती है
questions.explanation: Responding to stimuli similar to the conditioned stimulus is stimulus generalisation. (Q19 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: ........ proposed seven primary mental abilities present in intelligence.
questions.textHi: ........ ने बुद्धि में सम्मिलित सात प्राथमिक मानसिक योग्यताएँ बताईं।
questions.explanation: L.L. Thurstone proposed seven primary mental abilities. (Q20 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Raven's Progressive Matrices (RPM) is a ........ intelligence test.
questions.textHi: रेवेन प्रोग्रेसिव मैट्रिसेस (RPM) एक ........ बुद्धि परीक्षण है।
questions.explanation: Raven's Progressive Matrices is a non-verbal (culture-fair) intelligence test. (Q21 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Creativity primarily involves
questions.textHi: सृजनात्मकता में मुख्य रूप से शामिल है
questions.explanation: Creativity mainly involves divergent thinking. (Q22 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Piaget's concrete operational stage lies between
questions.textHi: पियाजे की मूर्त संक्रियात्मक अवस्था किस आयु के बीच होती है?
questions.explanation: The concrete operational stage spans roughly 7 to 11/12 years. (Q23 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: In an experiment, keeping the value of other variables zero or constant is called
questions.textHi: किसी प्रयोग में अन्य चरों के मान को शून्य या स्थिर रखना कहलाता है
questions.explanation: Keeping extraneous variables constant is experimental control. (Q24 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Behaviorism was propounded by
questions.textHi: व्यवहारवाद के प्रवर्तक कौन थे?
questions.explanation: J.B. Watson founded behaviourism (1913). (Q25 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: ........ is responsible for personality adjustment.
questions.textHi: व्यक्तित्व के समायोजन के लिए ........ उत्तरदायी है।
questions.explanation: The ego mediates between the id, super-ego and reality, so it is responsible for adjustment. (Q26 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Development follows a ........ sequence.
questions.textHi: विकास ........ क्रम का अनुसरण करता है।
questions.explanation: Development proceeds from the centre of the body outward (proximodistal). (Q27 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: A statement showing the relationship between variables is a
questions.textHi: चरों के बीच संबंध दर्शाने वाला कथन है
questions.explanation: A hypothesis is a testable statement of the relationship between variables. (Q28 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Modifying incoming new information to fit into already existing mental categories is called
questions.textHi: आने वाली नई सूचना को पहले से उपस्थित मानसिक श्रेणियों में फिट करने के लिए उसमें बदलाव करना कहलाता है
questions.explanation: Assimilation fits new information into existing schemas. (Q29 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Socialisation is mainly a ........ process.
questions.textHi: समाजीकरण मुख्यतः एक ........ प्रक्रिया है।
questions.explanation: Socialisation is mainly learned through interaction with family, school and society. (Q30 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: If the sides of a triangle are 11 cm, 15 cm and 16 cm, the altitude to the longest side is
questions.textHi: यदि किसी त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 11 सेमी, 15 सेमी और 16 सेमी हैं, तो सबसे लम्बी भुजा पर शीर्षलम्ब की लम्बाई है
questions.explanation: s = 21; area = √(21 × 10 × 6 × 5) = 30√7 cm²; altitude to 16 cm = 2 × 30√7/16 = 15√7/4 cm. (Q31 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: The length of each side of an equilateral triangle of area 4√3 cm² is
questions.textHi: 4√3 cm² क्षेत्रफल वाले समबाहु त्रिभुज की प्रत्येक भुजा की लम्बाई है
questions.explanation: (√3/4)a² = 4√3 gives a² = 16, so a = 4 cm. (Q32 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html
7.2 occurs four times, more than any other value. (Q33 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: If the ratio of the radii of two circles is 2 : 3, the ratio of their circumferences is
questions.textHi: यदि दो वृत्तों की त्रिज्याओं का अनुपात 2 : 3 है, तो उनकी परिधियों का अनुपात है
questions.explanation: Circumference is proportional to radius, so the ratio is 2 : 3. (Q34 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: The quotient when 5x² + 3x + 1 is divided by 2x is
questions.textHi: 5x² + 3x + 1 को 2x से भाग देने पर भागफल है
questions.explanation: (5x² + 3x + 1) ÷ 2x = (5/2)x + 3/2 with remainder 1. (Q35 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: The ratio of a side to a diagonal of a square is
questions.textHi: किसी वर्ग की भुजा और विकर्ण का अनुपात होता है
questions.explanation: Diagonal = side × √2, so side : diagonal = 1 : √2. (Q36 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: What time is 4 hrs 59 minutes before 2:58 p.m.?
questions.textHi: दोपहर 2:58 बजे से 4 घंटे 59 मिनट पहले क्या समय था?
questions.explanation: 2:58 p.m. − 4 h = 10:58 a.m.; − 59 min = 9:59 a.m. (Q37 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: The value of (x⁻¹ + y⁻¹)⁻¹ is
questions.textHi: (x⁻¹ + y⁻¹)⁻¹ का मान है
questions.explanation: 1/x + 1/y = (x + y)/xy; its reciprocal is xy/(x + y). (Q38 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: The simple interest on Rs 2000 at 25/4% per annum for the period from 4 February 2015 to 18 April 2015 is
questions.textHi: 2000 रुपये पर 25/4% वार्षिक दर से 4 फरवरी 2015 से 18 अप्रैल 2015 तक की अवधि का साधारण ब्याज है
questions.explanation: Days: 24 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 18 (Apr) = 73 = 1/5 year; SI = 2000 × 25/4 × 1/5 ÷ 100 = Rs 25. (Q39 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: In terms of profit percentage, which of the following is the best transaction?
questions.textHi: लाभ प्रतिशत के अनुसार निम्नलिखित में से सबसे अच्छा लेन-देन कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Profit %: 47.2%, 48%, 47.5% and 48.3%; the last is best. (Q40 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: The difference between the place value and the face value of 3 in 12345 is
questions.textHi: संख्या 12345 में 3 के स्थानीय मान तथा अंकित मान में अन्तर है
questions.explanation: Place value of 3 = 300, face value = 3; difference = 297. (Q41 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: The number of integers less than −3 but greater than −8 is
questions.textHi: −3 से छोटे परन्तु −8 से बड़े पूर्णांकों की संख्या है
questions.explanation: −7, −6, −5, −4: four integers. (Q42 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: The reciprocal of (−3/8) × (−7/13) is
questions.explanation: (−3/8) × (−7/13) = 21/104; reciprocal = 104/21. (Q43 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: The number of vertices of a polyhedron which has 30 edges and 12 faces is
questions.textHi: 30 किनारों और 12 फलकों वाले बहुफलक में शीर्षों की संख्या है
questions.explanation: Euler's formula V − E + F = 2: V = 30 − 12 + 2 = 20. (Q44 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: The difference between the LCM and the HCF of 5, 10 and 35 is
questions.textHi: 5, 10 और 35 के ल.स.प. और म.स.प. का अंतर है
questions.explanation: LCM = 70, HCF = 5; difference = 65. (Q45 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: The prime factorisations of a and b are a = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 and b = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 5. The LCM of a and b is
questions.textHi: दो संख्याओं a और b के अभाज्य गुणनखंड a = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 और b = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 5 हैं। a और b का ल.स.प. है
questions.explanation: LCM takes the highest powers: 2⁴ × 3² × 5². (Q46 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: The HCF of two numbers is 31 and their LCM is 186. If one number is 62, the other number is
questions.textHi: दो संख्याओं का म.स.प. 31 तथा ल.स.प. 186 है। यदि एक संख्या 62 है, तो दूसरी संख्या है
questions.explanation: Other number = 31 × 186 ÷ 62 = 93. (Q47 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: If a 150 m long train crosses a 100 m long platform in 10 seconds, its speed is
questions.textHi: यदि 150 मीटर लम्बी ट्रेन 100 मीटर लम्बे प्लेटफॉर्म को 10 सेकंड में पार करती है, तो ट्रेन की गति है
questions.explanation: Distance = 150 + 100 = 250 m in 10 s, so speed = 25 m/s. (Q48 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: The sum of the mode and the median of the data 12, 15, 11, 13, 18, 11, 13, 12, 13 is
questions.explanation: Sorted: 11, 11, 12, 12, 13, 13, 13, 15, 18; mode = 13, median = 13; sum = 26. (Q50 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: 2¹⁰ − 1 is divisible by
questions.textHi: 2¹⁰ − 1 किससे विभाज्य है?
questions.explanation: 2¹⁰ − 1 = 1023 = 3 × 341, so it is divisible by 3. (Q52 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: In a right-angled triangle, the sum of two acute angles is
questions.textHi: एक समकोण त्रिभुज में दो न्यून कोणों का योग होता है
questions.explanation: The angles add to 180° and one is 90°, so the two acute angles add to 90°. (Q53 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: The HCF of 1/2, 2/3, 3/4 and 4/5 is
questions.textHi: 1/2, 2/3, 3/4 और 4/5 का महत्तम समापवर्तक है
questions.explanation: HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators / LCM of denominators = 1/60. (Q54 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: If 603 × 28 = 63 × 4 × ____, then the number in the blank is
questions.explanation: 603 × 28 = 16884 and 63 × 4 = 252; 16884 ÷ 252 = 67. (Q56 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html
A non-terminating repeating decimal is a rational number. (Q57 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: If x + 1/x = 5, then x³ + 1/x³ is equal to
questions.textHi: यदि x + 1/x = 5, तो x³ + 1/x³ बराबर है
questions.explanation: x³ + 1/x³ = (x + 1/x)³ − 3(x + 1/x) = 125 − 15 = 110. (Q59 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: If △PQR ≅ △EFD, then ED =
questions.textHi: यदि △PQR ≅ △EFD, तो ED =
questions.explanation: P↔E, Q↔F, R↔D, so ED corresponds to PR. (Q60 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: PRESENCE
questions.explanation: Absence is the opposite of presence. (Q61 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: ACTIVE
questions.explanation: Lazy (inactive) is the opposite of active. (Q62 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: ADULT

questions.text: Who built the Nagarkot (Kangra) fort?
questions.textHi: नगरकोट (कांगड़ा) का किला किसने बनवाया था?
questions.explanation: Tradition credits Raja Susharma Chandra of the Katoch dynasty with building the Kangra (Nagarkot) fort. (Q141 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Members of the Rajya Sabha are elected for a term of ........ years.
questions.textHi: राज्य सभा के सदस्य ..... वर्ष की अवधि के लिए निर्वाचित होते हैं
questions.explanation: Rajya Sabha members serve six-year terms; one-third retire every two years. (Q142 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Balwant Rai Mehta committee was constituted in 1957 to
options: To bring about changes in India's industrial sector
To formulate policy to strengthen international trade
To study the Panchayati Raj system
questions.textHi: बलवंत राय मेहता समिति का गठन 1957 में किसलिए किया गया था?
optionsHi: भारत के औद्योगिक क्षेत्र में परिवर्तन लाने के लिए
अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार को सुदृढ़ करने की नीति बनाने के लिए
पंचायती राज व्यवस्था का अध्ययन करने के लिए
questions.explanation: The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) recommended three-tier Panchayati Raj. (Q143 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Judges of the Supreme Court retire at the age of
questions.textHi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश कितनी आयु में सेवानिवृत्त होते हैं?
questions.explanation: Supreme Court judges retire at 65 (High Court judges at 62). (Q144 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: In which district is the Kol Dam situated?

questions.text: The painting 'Kangra Bride' is the work of
questions.textHi: 'कांगड़ा दुल्हन' (Kangra Bride) पेंटिंग किसकी कृति है?

questions.text: Mica is used as a raw material in the ........ industry.
questions.textHi: अभ्रक का उपयोग ........ उद्योग में कच्चे माल के रूप में किया जाता है।
questions.explanation: Mica is an excellent electrical insulator used in the electrical industry. (Q148 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: National Voters' Day is observed every year on
questions.textHi: प्रत्येक वर्ष राष्ट्रीय मतदाता दिवस ……. को मनाया जाता है।

questions.text: When was the Indian national flag adopted by the Constituent Assembly?
questions.textHi: संविधान सभा द्वारा भारतीय राष्ट्रीय ध्वज कब अपनाया गया?
questions.explanation: The Constituent Assembly adopted the national flag on 22 July 1947. (Q150 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-2018-solved-paper-part-15.html
